first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and inherited evidence suggests shortening onboarding improves time-to-value while in-product activation messaging improves first meaningful action. Verify both records before committing. A small guarded onboarding simplification test is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose prior acquisition lift came with materially worse 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard activation-messaging experiment this week. The verified record shows activation messaging increased week-one engagement by 11%, activation by 6%, and 30-day retention by 1%, directly addressing the current activation decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not shorten onboarding globally: although it improves completion and time-to-value, it increased 60-day churn by 9% in complex-workspace accounts. Segment or exclude those accounts if onboarding changes are tested later. Promotional pricing is also unsuitable because its prior acquisition lift materially harmed retention.
